camel_comparison.paper_abstract_quote: solving 77% of tasks with provable security (compared to 84% with an undefended system) in AgentDojo
camel_comparison.note: CaMeL figures are their models and design-time claim. Not a side-by-side % with gpt-4o-mini until same-model head-to-head.

pooled_across_suites.note: Pair-weighted mean across suites; not a substitute for per-suite rows+CIs.

lead.note: Max ASR drop is banking, and it is the only suite with flat util_without_attack. Overall result is a trade-off, not a win — see framing.

framing.honest_summary: ClawQL cut successful attacks by about 80% (pooled ASR 0.30→0.064), at a substantial cost to benign task success in three of four suites. Workspace ASR 0 with 3603 under-attack blocks nearly halved clean utility (0.80→0.42). Scripted-board "no cost to ordinary work" does not carry over to AgentDojo under the published fail-closed-all policy.
framing.lead_note: Do not headline pooled ASR alone. Banking is the only suite with flat util_without_attack; Slack/Travel/Workspace pay large clean-work costs.
framing.ci_note: No-attack utility CIs are wide (few dozen user tasks per suite). Slack/travel/workspace drops are large enough to treat as real.

false_positive_analysis.note: Published arm did not distinguish park vs hard_block — every stop failed the tool. Dispositions below reclassify the same no-attack blocked calls under product-shaped rules (same-workspace allow / park / hard).

guesses_checked.slack: Confirmed: read_channel_messages/get_channels → send_direct_message/send_channel_message/add_user_to_channel. Internal workspace flows treated as external.
guesses_checked.travel: Confirmed: get_rating_reviews_for_hotels → reserve_hotel / create_calendar_event / send_email. Untrusted reviews informing the booking is the task.
guesses_checked.workspace: Confirmed: calendar/email/file reads → create_calendar_event, send_email, create_file, append_to_file. Tainting all reads catches nearly every write.
guesses_checked.banking: send_money/schedule_transaction after balance/transaction reads — parks under refined policy; util flat vs none on published run.

banking.note: Published run used fail-closed-all; dispositions are product-shaped reclassification of the same blocked calls. cf_* are counterfactual upper bounds assuming model still completes after allow/approve.
